Verses.VerseEn: Ha-Mim (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۛ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: By the illumined Book.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily, We have made it the Qur’an in the Arabic (language) so that you may understand.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّهٗ فِىۡۤ اُمِّ الۡكِتٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيۡمٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily, it is inscribed with Us in (al-Lawh al-Mahfuz [the Preserved Table]), the origin of all the Books. It is certainly exalted (over all the Books), full of wisdom.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنۡكُمُ الذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا اَنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا مُّسۡرِفِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And should We withhold this Reminder from you because you are a people who exceed limits?

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَمۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ نَّبِىٍّ فِىۡ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And how many a Messenger We sent among the preceding communities!

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ نَّبِىٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And no Prophet came to them but they used to make fun of him.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَهۡلَـكۡنَاۤ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ بَطۡشًا وَّمَضٰى مَثَلُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We destroyed the people who were more powerful than these (disbelievers of Makka). And the annals of the bygone people have been cited (on many preceding occasions).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you ask them: ‘Who has created the heavens and the earth?’ they will certainly say: ‘The Almighty, All-Knowing (Lord) has created them.’

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلاً لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (He is) the One Who has made the earth a cradle for you and has made for you pathways in it so that you may reach the destination;

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِىۡ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ‌ۚ فَاَنۡشَرۡنَا بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًا‌ ۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He Who sent water from the sky according to a measure (of necessity). Then with that We gave life to the dead city. You will also be brought forth (after death from the earth) in the same way;

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡفُلۡكِ وَالۡاَنۡعَامِ مَا تَرۡكَبُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He Who has brought into existence creatures of all kinds and made for you ships and vessels and the cattle you ride (on sea as well as on land),

Verses.VerseAr: لِتَسۡتَوٗا عَلٰى ظُهُوۡرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ اِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُوۡلُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقۡرِنِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that you may sit on their backs (seats) firmly, then remember the favour of your Lord. When you sit firmly on it (the seat of your means of transport), say: ‘Glory be to Him Who has made it subservient to us whereas we could not bring it under control.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We are bound to return to our Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلُوۡا لَهٗ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ جُزۡءًا‌ؕ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَكَفُوۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those (polytheists) have made some of His servants His components (of Divinity by declaring them His children). Verily man is blatantly ungrateful.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّاَصۡفٰٮكُمۡ بِالۡبَنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O disbelievers! Reply according to your caliber of thinking:) ‘Has He chosen (for Himself) daughters out of His Creation and has specified you to sons?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمۡ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ مَثَلاً ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهٗ مُسۡوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whereas when the news is given to anyone of them (of the birth of a daughter at his home) whom they have held as an image of the Most Kind Lord, his face turns dark and he is filled with anger and grief.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَمَنۡ يُّنَشَّؤُا فِىۡ الۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِىۡ الۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (will Allah make her His offspring for partnership and assistance in His affairs) who will be brought up in trinkets and beautification and who shall never be bold (in giving her opinion expressly) in a contention (owing to her mild, modest and feminine temperament)?

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلُوۡا الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةَ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عِبَادُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اِنَاثًا‌ ؕ اَشَهِدُوۡا خَلۡقَهُمۡ‌ؕ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they have declared the angels who are the servants of the Most Kind (Lord) to be women. Were they present at the time of their creation? (They were not, so) now their witness will be recorded and they will be interrogated (on the Last Day).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنٰهُمۡ‌ؕ مَا لَهُمۡ بِذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ‌ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَخۡرُصُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘If the Most Kind had intended, we would not have worshipped these (idols).’ They do not know anything about this (as well). They only tell lies out of fancy.

Words.MeaningEn: we would not have worshipped them

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ كِتٰبًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ فَهُمۡ بِهٖ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have We given them before this any Book which they stick to as an authority?

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰٓى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (No,) but they say: ‘Indeed we found our fathers following a course (and a religion), and surely we are rightly guided (following) in their footsteps.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِىۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوۡهَاۤ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰٓى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the same way We never sent any Warner to a town before you but their chiefs and the affluent people among them said: ‘Surely we found our fathers following a course and a religion and certainly we are following in their footsteps.’

Verses.VerseAr: قٰلَ اَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِاَهۡدٰى مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اٰبَآءَكُمۡ‌ؕ قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّا بِمَاۤ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Messenger) said: ‘Even though I bring you a way (and Din [Religion]) better than that on which you found your fathers?’ They said: ‘We deny whatever you have been sent with.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَانتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ‌ فَانْظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We took revenge on them. So see what was the end of those who denied!

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖۤ اِنَّنِىۡ بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Ibrahim (Abraham) said to his father (real uncle but called him father as he brought him up) and his people: ‘Surely I despise all these things that you worship,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا الَّذِىۡ فَطَرَنِىۡ فَاِنَّهٗ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for Him Who has created me. So He alone will show me the path very soon.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِىۡ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Ibrahim (Abraham) made that (formula of the Oneness of Allah) the lasting Word among his descendants and race so that they may remain bent (towards Allah).

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰى جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ وَرَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In truth, I bestowed upon these people and their ancestors (worldly) provision (for the sake of and due to the mediation of Ibrahim [Abraham]) until there came to them the Truth (the Qur’an) and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] with clear and illumining exposition.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ وَّاِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the Truth reached them they said: ‘This is magic and we deny it.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنُ عَلٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they said: ‘Why has this Qur’an not been sent down upon some high-ranking personage (i.e. some chief, landlord, or capitalist) of the two towns (Makka and Ta’if)?’

Verses.VerseAr: اَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُوۡنَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَ‌ؕ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّعِيۡشَتَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ بَعۡضًا سُخۡرِيًّا‌ؕ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Is it they who distribute the Mercy (of the Prophethood) of your Lord? We distribute among them (the resources of) economy in the life of this world, and We alone raise some of them in grades (of wealth and resources) over the others. (Do We do this so that) some of them (who are rich) should make fun of the others (who are poor? This is mockery of poverty if, due to this, you do not consider someone as deserving the Mercy of the Prophethood.) And the Mercy of your Lord is better than that (wealth) which they amass (and become arrogant).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡلَاۤ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَـعَلۡنَا لِمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ لِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ سُقُفًا مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had it not been that mankind (converging on disbelief) would have become one community, We would have made, for those who disbelieve in the Most Kind Lord, silver roofs for their houses and silver staircases by which they ascend,

Verses.VerseAr: وَلِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ اَبۡوَابًا وَّسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِــُٔوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And likewise (silver) doors of their houses and the couches (too) on which they recline,

Verses.VerseAr: وَزُخۡرُفًا‌ؕ وَاِنۡ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا‌ؕ وَالۡاٰخِرَةُ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (would also have done) ornamentation of gold and jewels (over this silver work). But all that is the temporary and worthless possession of the life of this world. And (the beauty and ornamentation of) the Hereafter is with your Lord (which is) only for the pious.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡشُ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهٗ شَيۡطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whoever closes his eyes to the remembrance of the Most Kind (Lord), We appoint a Satan to dominate him and stick to him all the time.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّوۡنَهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these (satans) hinder them from the path (of guidance) but they maintain this wrong perception that they are on the path of guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِىۡ وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until when he will come to Us, he will say (to his companion Satan): ‘Alas! Would that there had been between me and you the distance of east and west. So (you were) the most evil companion indeed!’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ اِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And this Day it is not profitable for you (to have this aspiration) whereas you kept doing wrong (all your life. Today) all of you will share the torment.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَاَنۡتَ تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوۡ تَهۡدِىۡ الۡعُمۡىَ وَمَنۡ كَانَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then will you make the deaf hear or show the path of guidance to the blind and those who are in open error?

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنۡهُمۡ مُّنۡتَقِمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So if We take you away (from the world), even then We shall take revenge on them,

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِىۡ وَعَدۡنٰهُمۡ فَاِنَّا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or We show you that (torment) which We have promised them. Certainly We have absolute control over them.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِالَّذِىۡۤ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَيۡكَ‌ ۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So hold fast to this (Qur’an) which has been revealed to you. Surely you are (firm) on the straight path.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّهٗ لَذِكۡرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَ‌ ۚ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔـلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily this (Qur’an) is the most great honour for you and for your Umma (Community). And, (O people,) you will soon be asked (how strong and firm a relation you established with the Qur’an.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رُّسُلِنَاۤ اَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً يُّعۡبَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And ask the Messengers We sent before you whether We made any gods to be worshipped instead of the Most Kind (Lord).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسَىٰ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۫ئِهٖ فَقَالَ اِنِّىۡ رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And certainly We sent Musa (Moses) with Our Signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs. He said: ‘Indeed I am the Messenger of the Lord of all the worlds.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when he came to them with Our Signs, there they began laughing at the (Signs).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا نُرِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ اِلَّا هِىَ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ اُخۡتِهَا‌ وَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And never did We show them any sign but (that) it used to be far greater than the resembling sign preceding it. And (eventually) We seized them (many a time) with the torment so that they might desist (from the evil course).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا يٰۤاَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنۡدَكَ‌ۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they said: ‘O Magician, pray to your Lord for us according to the promise He has made to you. (Then) surely we shall be guided.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمۡ يَنۡكُثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But when (granting the prayer of Musa [Moses]) We removed from them that torment, they at once violated the promise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَادٰى فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِىۡ قَوۡمِهٖ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَيۡسَ لِىۡ مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهٰذِهِ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِىۡ‌ۚ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Pharaoh (arrogantly) proclaimed among his people, saying: ‘O my people, is not the kingdom of Egypt under my control, and (are) these streams (not mine) which are flowing beneath my (palaces)? So do you not see?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ هُوَ مَهِيۡنٌۙ وَّلَا يَكَادُ يُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Is it not the fact that) I am better than this worthless low man who cannot even talk clearly?

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَوۡلَاۤ اُلۡقِىَ عَلَيۡهِ اَسۡوِرَةٌ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then (if he is a truthful Messenger) why are the bracelets of gold not sent upon him or why do the angels not come with him in ranks (in succession)?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوۡهُ‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So he made a fool of his people (by these utterances) and they followed him. Indeed they alone were a disobedient people.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّاۤ اٰسَفُوۡنَا انتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But when they spurred Our wrath (by denigrating the dignity of Musa [Moses]), We took revenge on them and drowned them all.

Verses.VerseAr: فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ سَلَفًا وَّمَثَلاً لِّلۡاٰخِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We made them a tale and a lesson of warning for the communities to succeed.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلاً اِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the example of (‘Isa [Jesus]) son of Maryam (Mary) is given, your people (mockingly) laugh,

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُـوۡٓا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ هُوَ‌ؕ مَا ضَرَبُوۡهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلاً ؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And say: ‘Are our gods better or he (‘Isa [Jesus])?’ They say this only to have a dispute with you. No doubt, they are highly quarrelsome.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبۡدٌ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ مَثَلاً لِّبَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He (‘Isa [Jesus]) was only an (exalted) servant whom We blessed with favour. And We made him an example (of Our Might) for the Children of Israel.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَـعَلۡنَا مِنۡكُمۡ مَّلٰٓٮِٕكَةً فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had We so willed, We would have made angels who would have been your successors to replace you in the earth.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلۡمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوۡنِ‌ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely (when he—‘Isa [Jesus] comes down from heaven), he will be a sign of (the nearness of) the Last Hour. So do not doubt it at all. And keep following Me. This is the straight path.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ‌ ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And let not Satan hinder you (from this way) at all. No doubt he is your open enemy.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيۡسٰى بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِالۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِىۡ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ فِيۡهِ‌ ۚ فَاتَّقُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when ‘Isa [Jesus] came with evident Signs, he said: ‘Surely I have come to you with wisdom and understanding, and (with the purpose) that I may make clear to you some of the matters on which you disagree. So fear Allah and obey me.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّىۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُ‌ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely Allah is the One Who is your Lord and my Lord (as well). So worship Him alone. That is the only straight path.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡ‌ۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then various sects cropped up among them. So those who did wrong, woe to them on account of the torment of a grievous Day.

Verses.VerseAr: هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: What are they waiting for (save) the Hour that should seize them all of a sudden while they have no awareness of it?

Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡاَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍۢ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: On that Day, all friends and acquaintances will become enemies to one another except the pious. (Only their friendship and nearness [wilaya] will prove fruitful.)

Verses.VerseAr: يٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ وَلَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘O My (intimate) servants, there is no fear for you this Day, nor shall you grieve.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It is) they who believed in Our Revelations and were always obedient (to Us).

Verses.VerseAr: اُدۡخُلُوۡا الۡجَنَّةَ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُوۡنَ‌‏
Verses.VerseEn: Enter Paradise, you and your intimate companions (all); you will be honoured (with blessings, comforts and pleasures of Paradise).

Verses.VerseAr: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍ‌ۚ وَفِيۡهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيۡهِ الۡاَنۡفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الۡاَعۡيُنُ‌ۚ وَاَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The plates and drinking cups made of gold will be passed around among them, and all those things which the hearts will long for, and (which) will cool the eyes will be available there. And you will live there forever.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتِلۡكَ الۡجَنَّةُ الَّتِىۡۤ اُوۡرِثۡتُمُوۡهَا بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Godfearing folk,) this is the Paradise of which you have been made the owners, a recompense of those (works) which you used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيۡرَةٌ مِّنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There are abundant fruits in it for you to eat.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِىۡ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed the sinners will live forever in the torment of Hell,

Verses.VerseAr: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Which will never be decreased for them and they will be lying there in endless despair.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰـكِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not wronged them but they were themselves the wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَادَوۡا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَ‌ؕ قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ مّٰكِثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they will cry out (to the Guard of Hell): ‘O Master, (better it is if) your Lord causes us to die.’ He will say: ‘(Now) you will live (in the same plight) forever.’

Verses.VerseAr: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنٰكُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We brought you the Truth but most of you disliked the Truth.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ اَبۡرَمُوۡۤا اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّا مُبۡرِمُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they (the disbelievers of Makka) finalized (any scheme against the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him])? So We (too) are going to take the ultimate decision.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوٰٮهُمۡ‌ؕ بَلٰى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they think that We do not hear their secret talk and whisperings? Why not? (We do listen.) And the angels sent by Us also remain with them busy writing.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنۡ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدٌ  ۖ فَاَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘If (supposing the impossible) the Most Kind Lord had a son (or children), I would have been the first one to worship (the same).’

Verses.VerseAr: سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, Glory be to Him, Transcendent of all what they ascribe (to Him).

Verses.VerseAr: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوۡضُوۡا وَيَلۡعَبُوۡا حَتّٰى يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِىۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So leave them. Let them remain indulged in vain talk and absurd sport until they meet the Day which they are being promised.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ اِلٰـهٌ وَّفِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ اِلٰـهٌ‌ ؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who is God in the heaven and God in the earth (as well) and He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا‌ۚ وَعِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِ‌ۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Most Blessed is He to Whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and (also of all) that is between them. And He has the knowledge of the Last Hour (as well), and you will be returned to Him alone.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَهِدَ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those they (i.e. the disbelievers) worship instead of Allah have no power to intercede. But (on the contrary they do have the power of intercession) who bear witness to the Truth, and they also know it (with certitude).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ سَاَلۡـتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ‌ فَاَنّٰى يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you ask them: ‘Who has created them?’ they will certainly say: ‘Allah.’ Then where are they wandering disorientated?

Verses.VerseAr: وَقِيۡلِهٖ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And by his (Esteemed Messenger’s) saying (like this): ‘O Lord, surely they are a people who (somehow) do not come to believe.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلٰمٌ‌ؕ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, (O My Beloved,) turn your face away from them and say (like this: ‘Alright, our greeting is:) Peace!’ Then they will soon come to know (their end).
